The '''Tatooine Moisture Farm Collective''', together with the [[Bestine Chamber of Commerce]], sometimes employed hunters on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] wild creatures known to damage the planet's [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporators]] or attack [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]].<ref name="SWG:KtWF" />
